title: 농촌계획 2025년 제31권 4호
headline: 이번 호의 핵심 흐름은 ‘어메니티 · 마을 · 자원’(7편)입니다. 가장 많이 등장한 키워드는 ‘Agricultural Environment Conservation Program’이며, 서울대학교 연구진이 6편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘Rural discourse’, ‘social network analysis · 사회연결망분석’, ‘여성농업인 실태조사’, ‘여성농업인 지위’, ‘영농참여율’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 설문조사, APEX, 원격탐사, AHP.

papers.title: 농촌지역 여성농업인의 영농참여율과 지위 결정 요인 분석 - 65세 미만 여성농업인을 대상으로 -
papers.title_en: Determinants of Agricultural Participation and Status among Rural Women Farmers - Evidence from Women Farmers under Age 65 -

summary.result: 분석 결과, 나이, 결혼 여부, 영농경력, 직무 교육 수강 여부, 농업 외 활동 의향, 농업 축소 여부 등이 영농참여율에 유의한 영향을 미쳤으며, 영농참여율이 높을수록 여성농업인의 농가 및 지역사회 내 지위가 상승하는 것으로 나타났다.
summary.background: 전체 농가인구의 약 1/2 이상을 차지하고 있는 여성농업인의 경영참여 촉진은 우리나라 농업의 지속적인 발전과 농촌지역 유지를 위해 중요한 과제이다.
summary.method: 반면, 영농참여율 증가는 경제적 지위와는 직접적으로 연결되지 않았다.

papers.title: 기초생활서비스 접근성 기반의 섬 지역 생활권 유형화
papers.title_en: Identifying Island Living Area Types through Clustering of Basic Service Accessibility
keywords: Peripheral areas of the national territory

summary.result: Key services-healthcare, education, culture, commerce, and transportation-were used to derive accessibility indicators.
summary.background: The findings highlight the need for differentiated strategies in service provision and spatial planning.
summary.method: Using QGIS-based network analysis and clustering methods, accessibility was measured at both local and regional levels for 321 inhabited islands with available, maritime transport data.

papers.title: 농업·농촌 정보체계의 활용도와 접근성에 관한 실증적 분석 - 사업 실무자 설문조사를 중심으로 -
papers.title_en: An Analysis of the Utilization and Accessibility of Agricultural and Rural Information framework Based on a Survey of Project Practitioners

summary.result: Future research should expand to include local governments, research institutes, and private sectors to improve the policy applicability and inclusiveness of the system.
summary.background: A total of 91 information items were categorized into four domains-soil, drainage, farming, and farmland-and analyzed using the Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA) method combined with the Wilcoxon signed-rank test to ensure statistical robustness.
summary.method: Based on these findings, this study proposes four directions for improving the agricultural and rural information system: (1) building an integrated information framework reflecting user demand, (2) refining data disclosure standards to enhance accessibility while protecting privacy, (3) developing data-based planning guidelines and spatial decision-support tools, and (4) constructing a comprehensive data integration platform linking internal, external, and field data.

papers.title: 농촌특화지구 제도 운용 방안 연구
papers.title_en: A Study on the Operational Measures for Rural Specialization Districts

summary.result: Future institutional and policy refinements should be a continuous process, informed by practical experience gained from empirical evaluations and citizen participation once local governments have established their master and implementation plans.
summary.background: Through a theoretical review of rural spatial planning following the Act's implementation, the research establishes its distinct scope.
summary.method: Based on these insights, the study identifies key policy tasks, including the development of detailed designation criteria for each RSD type, the management of RSD-related information systems, and the formulation of project plans tailored to district characteristics.

papers.title: 농업환경보전프로그램 이행점검을 위한 시스템 설계
papers.title_en: Design of the Compliance Monitoring System for the Agricultural Environment Conservation Program

summary.result: The proposed system provides a foundation for quantitative performance management, systematic implementation oversight, and automation of field operations, and is expected to enhance the execution of agricultural environmental policies and contribute to the realization of a sustainable agricultural environment.
summary.background: The Agricultural Environment Conservation Program, implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs (MAFRA) since 2018, is a region-based environmental initiative aimed at reducing the environmental burden of agricultural activities through the promotion of eco-friendly farming practices, reduction of pesticide and fertilizer use, and protection of soil and water resources.
summary.method: The system adopts a client-server architecture and incorporates advanced ICT technologies such as customized UI/UX, external API-based data collection, relational database storage, GeoJSON-based spatial visualization, and role-based access control.

papers.title: 체류형 농원 주택과 텃밭 규모 영향요인에 대한 연구
papers.title_en: A Study on the Determinants of Housing and Vegetable Garden Size in Residential Farm

summary.result: Third, with respect to vegetable garden size, individuals showed a preference for larger garden sizes when cost factors are lower, when the respondent is male, and when the length of stay is longer.
summary.background: In this study, a survey was conducted targeting potential users demanders of residential farm to analyze the factors influencing the size of residential housing and vegetable garden within such farms.
summary.method: Second, regarding housing size, it was found that individuals tend to prefer larger-scale residential farm housing when utility factors are higher, when the age group is younger, and when the intended length of stay is longer.

papers.title: 농촌 담론 변화 분석을 위한 농촌개발사업지침 텍스트마이닝 분석
papers.title_en: Text Mining the Rural Development Guidelines to Analyze Rural Discourse Change

summary.result: The results showed that the term "village" remained central throughout all periods, highlighting the enduring village-oriented focus of rural policy.
summary.background: Traditionally perceived as production-oriented spaces, rural areas have increasingly been recognized for their cultural and environmental values due to industrialization, urbanization, population decline, and the dissolution of traditional communities.
summary.method: The analysis incorporated noun-based frequency analysis, social network analysis, and topic modeling.

papers.title: 지형지위지수를 활용한 고창군 농촌 구릉지 경관 분류
papers.title_en: A Topographic-Based Classification of Rural Landscapes in the Hilly Terrain of Gochang-gun Using the Topographic Position Index (TPI)

summary.result: Differentiated management strategies, such as ecological conservation, agricultural environment management, and mixed-use development, were proposed for each type.
summary.background: In response to the implementation of rural space restructuring policies, this study aimed to complement the limitations of existing urban planning-centered approaches and move beyond amenity-based resource classification by attempting a landscape interpretation that reflects topography, water systems, and spatial structure.
summary.method: After correlation analysis and standardization (Z-score), K-means clustering analysis (K=3) was conducted to classify Gochang's hilly areas into forest-type, facility farmland-type, and grassland-type.

papers.title: 농업환경보전프로그램 효과성 제고 방안 분석 - 정수계획 모형 기반 접근 -
papers.title_en: Analyzing Policy Measures to Improve the Effectiveness of the Agri-Environmental Conservation Program - An Integer Programming Approach -

summary.result: The scenario analysis demonstrated that an optimization approach based on environmental benefits and costs substantially improves both the cost and environmental effectiveness of individual activities.
summary.background: The Agri-Environmental Conservation Program (AECP) is the most comprehensive agri-environmental payment scheme in Korea, encompassing a wide range of activities.
summary.method: To this end, policy scenarios for the AECP were developed with reference to previous literature on agri-environmental payment schemes.

papers.title: 국제 사례 비교를 통한 한국형 위성영상 기반 작황 모니터링 시스템 설계 방안
papers.title_en: Designing a Korean Satellite Imagery-Based Agricultural Monitoring System through Comparative Analysis of International Approaches

summary.result: The analysis showed that all four systems share the common feature of integrating satellite-derived vegetation indices with meteorological data to assess crop conditions and yields.
summary.background: At the same time, their variations in scope, objectives, and delivery methods illustrate how system designs are adapted to specific regional and policy needs.
summary.method: The MARS combines vegetation indices with crop growth models to deliver precision yield forecasts designed to support EU agricultural policies.

papers.title: 한국 농업 ODA의 발전 경로 연구 - 미국의 원조수혜에서 동남아 공여로 -
papers.title_en: A Study on the Evolutionary Path of Korea's Agricultural ODA - From U.S. Assistance to Aid to Southeast Asia -

summary.result: The study contributes to the literature by proposing a structured, data-driven model for evaluating agricultural ODA and by suggesting policy implications for tailoring country-specific ODA strategies according to each recipient's position along the Foundation-Performance-Self-Reliance pathway.
summary.background: The results show that Korea's agricultural ODA broadly mirrors the developmental pathway shaped by U.S. assistance: initial foundational support for institutional and human capacity building, followed by productivity-enhancing interventions, and, more recently, support for research, policy, and value-chain development aimed at self-reliance.
summary.method: Using historical documents on U.S. agricultural aid to Korea and CRS-based statistical data for Korea's agricultural ODA, the study classifies projects into the three stages and compares their composition over time and across countries.

papers.title: 농외소득 상한기준을 활용한 공익직불금의 생산 비연계 검증
papers.title_en: valuating the Decoupling of Public Direct Payments Using an Upper Threshold of Off-Farm Income

summary.result: By empirically examining the linkage between the scheme and production using the off-farm income threshold as the cutoff, this study provides a useful foundation for future reforms and policy evaluation of direct payment schemes in agriculture.
summary.background: The Public Direct Payment Scheme was introduced as a decoupled income support policy while enhancing the public functions of agriculture and rural areas.
summary.method: Land area and labor hours, the key production factors, were set as dependent variables in our RDD experiments.

papers.title: 중심지 계층구조 분석 개선을 위한 공간분석 범위에 따른 비교 연구 - 고창군과 인근 읍면을 대상으로 -
papers.title_en: A Comparative Study of Spatial Analysis Scopes for Improving Central-Place Hierarchy Analysis - Targeting Gochang-gun and Adjacent Eup/Myeon -

summary.result: Analyzing only Gochang showed centrality concentrated in Gochang-eup; including adjacent towns pushed several myeon to lower tiers, indicating that peripheral areas may rely on centers in neighboring counties rather than Gochang-eup.
summary.background: Using 42 SOC functions from the Rural Spatial Information System, facilities were deduplicated and aggregated at the legal-ri (eup/myeon seat) level; sectoral totals were rescaled to 100 to obtain location coefficients, from which functional indices and centrality shares were computed.
summary.method: A risk of overvaluation was observed for sports and rest facilities due to rarity, implying potential metric distortion relative to core public functions such as hospitals and emergency services.

papers.title: 중국산 김치 수입 관세 철폐가 국내 배추 시장에 미치는 영향분석
papers.title_en: An Analysis of the Impact of Chinese Kimchi Import Tariff Elimination on the Korean Chinese Cabbage Market

papers.title: VR 테라피 프로그램을 활용한 사용자 유형별 생리적 변화 및 사용성 평가 - HRV, SSQ 및 사용성 평가 -
papers.title_en: An Analysis of the Physiological Changes and Usability Evaluation of Virtual Reality-Based Therapeutic Programs by User Type - HRV, SSQ and Usability Test -

summary.result: Regarding SDNN and RMSSD, the general population showed statistically significant improvement in SDNN and RMSSD; the elderly showed no significant changes, while individuals with disabilities showed limited improvement.
summary.background: The assessment used Oculus Quest 2 and the CheerU VR program.
summary.method: Statistical analyses were performed using ANOVA and Chi-squared tests using SPSS.

papers.title: 농촌공간계획 수립을 위한 팜맵 기반 농경지 변화 분석 및 적용 방안 연구
papers.title_en: Integrating Farm Map-Based Farmland Change Analysis into Rural Spatial Planning - A Framework for Practical Application -

summary.result: Overall, Farm Map-based spatial diagnostics strengthen the scientific foundation of rural spatial planning, contributing to sustainable land use and the preservation of rurality.
summary.background: Using Farm Map datasets from 2017 and 2024 for Yangsan City, South Korea, the research identifies land-use transitions through change detection and spatial hotspot analysis to diagnose development pressures in peri-urban rural areas undergoing rapid land conversion.
summary.method: Hotspot analysis using the Getis-Ord Gi* statistic revealed statistically significant clusters of farmland loss concentrated in southern Mulgeum-eup, southwestern Dong-myeon, and along major transport corridors in Sangbuk-myeon and Habuk-myeon.

papers.title: 농업환경보전프로그램 농업 재배활동의 넥서스 기반 영향 평가 체계 구축 및 활용
papers.title_en: Development and Application of a Nexus-based Impact Assessment Framework for Agricultural Cultivation Activities in the Agricultural Environment Conservation Program

summary.result: The current framework focuses on crops with available datasets but can be further advanced by obtained crop parameters, improving validation with field measured data, and linking additional quantitative modules for non-modeling practices.
summary.background: While agricultural intensification has improved productivity, it has also increased environmental burdens such as greenhouse gas emissions and nutrient pollution.
summary.method: The results were standardized as relative change rates from reference activities, and an integrated nexus impact index was calculated using a radar-type approach integrating five nexus elements.

papers.title: 농업환경보전프로그램의 농업환경 영향평가를 위한 시스템 개발
papers.title_en: Development of an Agricultural Environment Impact Assessment System for the Agricultural Environment Conservation Program

summary.result: The framework quantifies differences between baseline practices and conservation activities by calculating core indicators using the APEX/APEX-paddy model and country-specific coefficients.
summary.background: Existing evaluation methods-primarily based on awareness surveys or individual indicators-have been limited in assessing the program's overall environmental effects.
summary.method: The system developed in this study enhances the efficiency and transparency of AECP operation by providing a scientifically grounded evaluation methodology.

papers.title: 공동체부문 농업환경보전프로그램 대상지 선정기준 개선 및 중요도 조사
papers.title_en: Improvement of Community-based Village Selection Criteria and Importance Survey for the Agricultural Environment Conservation Program

summary.result: The importance analysis of each evaluation criteria showed that items related to community capacity, such as resident participation rate, plan participation and capacity-building efforts, were generally considered the most important.
summary.background: The selection of target villages is a critical process that determines the success or failure of program implementation.
summary.method: Two online surveys assessed criteria validity and the weighting of each evaluation criteria using the Analytic Hierarchy Process(AHP) technique.
